prompt:

Palette: #FFF8F0, #F7C6C7, #CDB4DB, #BDE0C6, #FFF1B5, #5B4636.

Character Cast: Recurring duo: 'Tũn', a young man with a round face, messy short black hair and dot eyes; and 'Mây', a young woman with a round face, shoulder-length black hair with a small clip and dot eyes; both drawn in simple chibi-like proportions. Outfit: Tũn wears a flat mint (#BDE0C6) hoodie; Mây wears a flat blush (#F7C6C7) cardigan.

Scene Composition: The channel character stands centered in the frame, pointing upwards with a welcoming smile. Clean, minimalist composition with at least 60% open negative space on the solid flat background.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text in the upper third integrated directly onto the flat canvas (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "THƯƠNG CHO KHÉO".
